derivation:
by
  simp only [circlePunctureIntersectionLinearVector, hp, PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, circlePunctureIntersectionRepresentative_false_second, smul_eq_mul]
  exact convex_Ioi (𝕜 := ℝ) 0 (by norm_num) (by simpa [circlePunctureIntersectionComponent] using hp) (by simpa only [sub_nonneg] using t.2.2) t.2.1 (by simp)
